page.overview:
Who is Petunia Petals?

Petunia Petals is a female Earth pony and supporting character in the hour-long special My Little Pony: Rainbow Roadtrip. She is the manager of Hope Hollow's Hotel Hope (among several other positions) and, later, Mayor Sunny Skies' fiancée.

Petunia Petals, like other Hope Hollow residents, speaks with an Upper Midwestern accent.

When Twilight Sparkle later visits the library, Petunia assists her in finding books on several subjects of magic. Later, in the hotel's "Rainbow Room", after Mayor Sunny quickly leaves to work on a speech, Petunia tells Twilight the history of the Rainbow Festival and shows her the destroyed Rainbow Generator. The two then work together to use the Generator to restore the town's color. When Petunia offers to help Sunny with his speech, he declines and quickly leaves again.

As the Rainbow Festival begins and Sunny fully restores the town's color by activating the Generator, he reveals that the speech he was working on was a marriage proposal to Petunia, who happily accepts. Petunia then celebrates the return of the town's color with the Mane Six and the rest of Hope Hollow during the song Living in Color, and she and Sunny bid farewell to the Mane Six as they leave in their repaired hot air balloon.
